test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E and F, each has a different height. C is taller than only two other friends. D is shorter than only one friend. B is shorter than C but taller than E. A is shorter than F. Who is the second shortest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Six friends A, B, C, D, E, and F.

1) C is taller than only two other friends. 

__ > __ > __ > C > __ > __

2) D is shorter than** only one friend**.

__ > D > __ > C > __ > __

3) B is shorter than C but taller than E.

__ > D > __ > C > B > E

4) A is shorter than F

F > D > A > C > B > E

After combining all the arrangements, we get:

F > D > A > C > B > E

Here, B is the second shortest among all the friends.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
